recommendation: Keep the source correction as-is. No further FHIR-core work appears necessary for this issue because the condition search parameter exists and publishes correctly; this change removes a stale source inconsistency that could confuse source review or future tooling.
issue_request: FHIR-31659 is Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested adding a search parameter for ResearchStudy.condition to support finding studies by condition or disease.
initial_application: The requested SearchParameter was already present in source/researchstudy/bundle-ResearchStudy-search-params.xml and appears to have been added by 54d65efcc8a70d79c299324443b75d6609f2d826 on 2021-04-07, despite that commit subject naming other Jira keys. The added entry had id ResearchStudy-condition, path/expression ResearchStudy.condition, code condition, and type token, but its url remained http://hl7.org/fhir/build/SearchParameter/ResearchStudy-category.
additional_context: ResearchStudy is an active resource in source/fhir.ini, and ResearchStudy.condition is a current element in structuredefinition-ResearchStudy.xml. A later commit removed the obsolete ResearchStudy.category SearchParameter after the element was removed. Published R5 and current build aggregate search-parameters.xml both render ResearchStudy-condition with the correct canonical URL, so the visible spec already satisfied the request; the remaining problem was the inconsistent active source input.
reconciliation: Changed source/researchstudy/bundle-ResearchStudy-search-params.xml to use http://hl7.org/fhir/build/SearchParameter/ResearchStudy-condition for the ResearchStudy-condition source SearchParameter URL, matching its id, code, expression, and generated canonical identity.
source_changes: source/researchstudy/bundle-ResearchStudy-search-params.xml: changed the ResearchStudy-condition SearchParameter url from ResearchStudy-category to ResearchStudy-condition.
